introHtml: The Bangkapi–Khlong Chan area sits on Bangkok's eastern edge, anchored by The Mall Bangkapi Lifestyle Store — a full-floor complex with HarborLand indoor waterpark, supermarket, cinema, and restaurants. The Yellow Line MRT links the district to the city's central interchange network, and Suvarnabhumi Airport is just 20–25 minutes by car. Accommodation prices here run well below Silom and Sukhumvit for the same or better star rating. We reviewed all five properties in depth — every entry includes direct booking links on three platforms, honest pros and cons, and a clear picture of who each property suits best. Prices from THB 500–874/night.
mrtHtml: The Yellow Line MRT (MRT Saen Saep) is the district's main rail connection. Bang Kapi Station (Yellow Line) is just 530–660 m from Mall Suites Hotel — the closest walkable rail access in this roundup. Lam Sali Station (Yellow Line) is approximately 5 minutes by car from imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi and Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130. For @81 Hotel, Lam Sali is 1.5 km away — a 5-minute Grab ride. Aunchaleena Grand Hotel in the Wang Thonglang sub-district is closest to Hua Mak Station (Yellow Line) at approximately 1.5 km. All properties except Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 offer free parking for guests who drive. Suvarnabhumi Airport is 18–25 km from the area, approximately 20–30 minutes by car.

entries.storyHtml: Hotel Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 has operated on Soi Lat Phrao 130 Yaek 2 since 2002 and is widely known in the neighbourhood as the place where rooms are bigger than the price implies. Score 9.1/10 from 92 Trip.com reviews, cleanliness 9.3, location 9.3, value 9.1 — the highest composite score in this roundup. Rooms include a private balcony, queen bed, fridge, cable TV, and wall-mounted air-con. Starting from THB 500/night, the lowest price in this roundup. Honest caveat: no parking (No Parking policy clearly stated), no breakfast, Wi-Fi can be unstable — bring mobile data as backup. A THB 1,000 cash deposit is required at check-in and returned in full at check-out. The reception counter is in a separate building from the rooms, which confuses some guests on the first visit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Do not drive — no parking available. Arrive by Grab or motorbike taxi. Prepare THB 1,000 in cash for the refundable deposit at check-in. Local food stalls outside the entrance open early, making breakfast easy to sort.

entries.storyHtml: @81 Hotel opened in 2020 and completed a renovation in 2024 — 80 rooms on a quiet side-soi off Ramkhamhaeng 81. Score 8.7/10 from 96 Trip.com reviews. The dominant theme across guest feedback is that rooms feel bigger and more comfortable than the price implies: a large King bed, strong air-conditioning, clean linens, and attentive staff. Free parking for both indoor and covered outdoor spaces is a real draw for guests with cars. The Mall Bangkapi is 3 minutes by car or Grab. Honest caveat: no lift in the building — guests with heavy luggage should request a lower-floor room; no breakfast served; Wi-Fi in some rooms can be weak — carry mobile data backup.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a renovated room (2024 upgrade) when booking or at check-in to get the best finish available. If you have heavy luggage, ask for a ground-floor room — there is no lift.

entries.storyHtml: Aunchaleena Grand Hotel is a 302-room 3-star hotel in the Wang Thonglang sub-district, adjacent to Ramkhamhaeng road. The standout factor no other hotel in this roundup can match is the combination of an outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, and spa-massage service — all at a starting price of THB 700/night. Score 7.9/10 from 216 reviews, location 8.3, value 8.2. Rajamangala National Stadium — Thailand's largest venue, used for major concerts and sporting events — is just 900 m away on foot (12–15 min walk or 3-min drive). 24-hour room service, restaurant, bar, and kids club. Honest caveat: cleanliness consistency has been flagged by some reviewers (isolated pest reports); Wi-Fi weak in some upper-floor rooms; location requires a Grab or car for most MRT connections.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book at least 2–4 weeks ahead when Rajamangala Stadium has a major concert or match — rooms fill fast and prices rise sharply. Prepare THB 500 in cash for the refundable deposit at check-in. If you encounter a cleanliness issue, report it immediately — the front desk will arrange a room change.

entries.storyHtml: imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi Bangkok (formerly The Pantip Hotel Ladprao) is a 212-room 3-star property in the Imperial Hotels group, located on Soi Lat Phrao 127. Score 7.9/10 from 280 Trip.com reviews, staff 8.0, value 8.2. The property offers free parking at the rear of the building, a morning breakfast buffet including Halal dishes (06:00–10:00), a fitness room, on-site restaurant, and 24-hour front desk. The Mall Bangkapi and Yellow Line MRT Lam Sali station are approximately 5 minutes by car. Suvarnabhumi Airport is 20–25 minutes by car — considerably better value than airport hotels for a pre-flight night. Honest caveat: a fresh market nearby produces odours in the early morning, especially in lower-floor rooms facing the market; lift malfunctions have been reported in some periods; noise bleed between some rooms with thinner partition walls.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a room on a higher floor or facing the main road to minimise early-morning market odours. Suvarnabhumi Airport is 20–25 min by car — imm hotel rates are far better value than airport-side hotels for a pre-departure stay.

entries.storyHtml: Mall Suites Hotel opened in 2010 and was last renovated in 2023 — 127 rooms directly beside The Mall Bangkapi Lifestyle Store and with Lotus supermarket opposite the entrance. Location score 8.9 from 301 reviews — the highest location rating in this roundup by a clear margin. Yellow Line MRT Bang Kapi Station is 530–660 m on foot, the most walkable rail access in this group. Suite rooms (from THB 1,300) include a compact kitchenette with fridge and microwave — families and longer-stay guests consistently mention this as a practical money-saver. Thai massage spa, free parking, and Halal dining are additional advantages. Honest caveat: the building shows its age clearly — hallways, furnishings, and common areas feel dated; some rooms have been flagged for dust and a slightly stale odour; unexpected add-on charges (e.g. THB 40 for extra towels) have appeared in reviews.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For stays of more than two nights or for families, upgrade to the One Bedroom Suite with kitchenette — the saving on meals makes the price difference worthwhile. Tops Supermarket inside The Mall (5-min walk) makes stocking the kitchenette easy.

faqTitle: FAQ — Budget Hotels in Bangkapi Bangkok

faq.q: ❓ What is the best budget hotel in Bangkapi Bangkok?
faq.a: It depends on your priority. For the highest guest score at the lowest price, Hotel Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 (THB 500, score 9.1 from 92 reviews) stands apart — rooms are spacious and clean well above what the price suggests. For a renovated 3-star with free parking and a quick drive to The Mall, @81 Hotel (THB 650, score 8.7) is the pick. For a swimming pool, fitness, and spa, Aunchaleena Grand Hotel (THB 700) is the only option in this roundup. For chain-hotel consistency with free parking and breakfast, imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi (THB 700). For the closest location to The Mall and walkable MRT access with a kitchenette option, Mall Suites Hotel (from THB 874).

faq.q: ❓ Which Bangkapi hotel is closest to the Yellow Line MRT?
faq.a: Mall Suites Hotel is the closest — Bang Kapi Station (Yellow Line MRT) is just 530–660 m away on foot, a comfortable walk under 10 minutes. imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi is approximately 5 minutes by car from Lam Sali Station. @81 Hotel is approximately 1.5 km from Lam Sali — a 5-minute Grab ride. Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 is roughly 10–12 minutes away by motorbike taxi from Lam Sali Station.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotel in Bangkapi is closest to The Mall Bangkapi Lifestyle Store?
faq.a: Mall Suites Hotel is the closest to The Mall Bangkapi — a 5-minute walk, with Lotus supermarket directly opposite the hotel entrance. @81 Hotel is a 3-minute drive. Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 and imm hotel Ladprao are approximately 5 minutes by car. Aunchaleena Grand Hotel in Wang Thonglang is the furthest, approximately 4 km.

faq.q: ❓ How far is Bangkapi from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: The Bangkapi–Khlong Chan area sits on Bangkok's eastern side, relatively close to Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK). Aunchaleena Grand Hotel is closest at 10–12 km (15–25 min drive) and offers an airport shuttle for approximately THB 1,200/trip. Mall Suites Hotel is approximately 18 km (20–25 min drive). imm hotel Ladprao is approximately 20–25 min by car. A Grab from any of these hotels to Suvarnabhumi costs approximately THB 150–250 depending on traffic.

faq.q: ❓ Do all these hotels offer free parking?
faq.a: Four of the five hotels in this roundup offer free parking. @81 Hotel provides free indoor and outdoor parking. imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi has free parking at the rear of the hotel. Aunchaleena Grand Hotel and Mall Suites Hotel both have free on-site parking. Hotel Grand Mandarin Latphrao 130 has a clear No Parking policy — guests must arrive by Grab, taxi, or motorbike taxi.

faq.q: ❓ Is there a hotel in Bangkapi with a swimming pool?
faq.a: Aunchaleena Grand Hotel is the only property in this roundup with an outdoor swimming pool, and it also comes with a fitness centre and spa-massage service — unusual at the THB 700/night starting price. The other four hotels do not have swimming pools. If a pool is essential, Aunchaleena Grand Hotel is the clear choice in this area, particularly for guests attending events at Rajamangala Stadium.
